recipes.name: Code Map
recipes.summary: Adds a lightweight code-map discipline to agent development work.
recipes.description: Prompts agents to inspect or update a compact project code map before implementation, then reports whether the map was used through a managed prompt-module mutation set.

skills.summary: Keeps a concise project code map aligned with implementation work.

agents.summary: Applies the code-map discipline during coding and verification tasks.

scenarios.name: Create or Refresh Code Map
scenarios.summary: Create or refresh a compact project code map before implementation.
scenarios.description: Use this when a task touches multiple code areas or when the repository lacks a current map of entry points, runtime surfaces, and verification commands.
use_when: A coding task spans multiple modules or ownership boundaries.
A new agent needs a quick map of the project's runtime surfaces.
A change depends on understanding entry points and verification commands.
avoid_when: The task is a one-line change with an obvious local owner.
The repository already has a current code map for the touched area.

prompt_modules.summary: Recipe-owned policy module for code-map discipline.

prompt_mutation_sets.summary: Registers the code-map policy module in the managed prompt graph.

recipes.name: Hermes Agentplane
recipes.summary: Adds prompt policy for Agentplane-owned Hermes Kanban worker lanes.
recipes.description: Prompts agents and Hermes worker profiles to treat Hermes as dispatch/run lifecycle and Agentplane as engineering task truth, using route-gated execution, comment-first projection, and terminal evidence gates.

skills.summary: Keeps Hermes worker lanes route-gated and Agentplane-owned.

agents.summary: Supervises one Hermes claim by executing at most one allowlisted Agentplane route step.

scenarios.name: Dispatch Agentplane Task Through Hermes
scenarios.summary: Project an Agentplane task into Hermes Kanban and supervise it through the native Hermes adapter.
scenarios.description: Use this when a repository wants Hermes to own queueing, claims, retries, dashboard, and handoff while Agentplane remains the canonical owner of plan, worktree, verification, finish, and ACR evidence.
use_when: Hermes Kanban is the operational board for multi-agent work.
Agentplane branch_pr should protect concurrent repo work.
A worker lane must complete Hermes cards only after Agentplane terminal evidence validates.
avoid_when: The repository does not run Hermes Kanban.
The task is a single local direct-mode helper run.
The integration cannot provide Hermes lifecycle callbacks or a dispatcher lane.

prompt_modules.summary: Recipe-owned policy module for Hermes Agentplane worker lanes.

prompt_mutation_sets.summary: Registers Hermes Agentplane worker lane discipline in the managed prompt graph.

recipes.name: LLM Wiki
recipes.summary: Adds an agent-maintained project wiki with raw-source ingestion, query routing, and stale-input guardrails.
recipes.description: Prompts agents to maintain a project-local llm-wiki namespace with an input inbox, immutable raw archive, structured wiki pages, index-based retrieval, and an explicit assimilation stop rule before unrelated task work.

skills.summary: Maintains a project-local LLM wiki from raw incoming sources.

agents.summary: Owns wiki initialization, source assimilation, index maintenance, and query retrieval discipline.

scenarios.name: Initialize or Assimilate LLM Wiki
scenarios.summary: Create the llm-wiki structure or assimilate incoming source files before project work continues.
scenarios.description: Use this when a repository needs an agent-maintained wiki, when llm-wiki/_input contains unprocessed files, or when project knowledge must be structured before answering or implementation.
use_when: The project has no llm-wiki namespace yet.
llm-wiki/_input or the configured input directory contains unprocessed files.
A request depends on project knowledge that should be routed through llm-wiki/index.md.
avoid_when: The task is unrelated and the configured input directory is empty.
The repository deliberately does not want a tracked wiki namespace.

prompt_modules.summary: Recipe-owned policy module for LLM wiki source assimilation and retrieval discipline.

prompt_mutation_sets.summary: Requires the LLM wiki policy module to be present when the recipe is active.

recipes.name: Parallel Codex Runners
recipes.summary: Plan and supervise independent Codex task runners with AgentPlane run observability.
recipes.description: Adds an operator recipe for splitting approved work into independent AgentPlane tasks, launching each through the Codex runner, and monitoring progress with task run status, inspect, and logs commands.

skills.summary: Coordinates multiple independent Codex task runners without sharing lifecycle authority.

agents.summary: Splits approved work into independent runner tasks and monitors their run artifacts.

scenarios.name: Coordinate Parallel Codex Runners
scenarios.summary: Split safe work into independent AgentPlane tasks and supervise each Codex runner.
scenarios.description: Use this when a parent task has separable work packages that can run concurrently without writing the same files or sharing lifecycle authority.
use_when: The parent scope can be split into independent child tasks with non-overlapping file ownership.
Each child can produce its own verification evidence and result manifest.
You need live progress visibility while several Codex runners execute.
avoid_when: The work requires a single shared edit across the same files.
The task needs continuous human judgement before each child can proceed.
The workflow mode or policy requires one linear owner to perform all changes.
